findings_to_judge.finding: Tonight's 10-Q is the first Domo filing issued after the deal was signed (7/22), HSR early-terminated (8/25) and the close pulled forward to end-September with no financing condition - which under ASC 205-40 gives management a strong basis to remove the 'substantial doubt exists about the Company's ability to continue as a going concern' language carried in the Q1 10-Q, a machine-readable flag change arriving with no press release or call to dilute it.

Domo paid ~$5.9m of cash lender and legal fees on effectiveness of the June 12 forbearance - i.e. inside the quarter being reported tonight - against cash of $39.1m at 4/30, while the purchase price is '$400m minus the amount, if any, by which $25 million (the Minimum Cash Amount) exceeds our estimation' of cash, with 'no upward adjustment' for cash above $25m; so the 7/31 cash line lands in a narrow corridor where a shortfall cuts proceeds dollar-for-dollar and an excess is transferred to Progress for free.
